column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 14 (M24014): Sangvis Ferri & Griffin membalikkan pertempuran,
# Lentine memerintahkan mundur, lalu Kalina menenangkan Mayling di reruntuhan The Elmo.
# Tetap Inggris: Paradajz, Mangi Security, Dushevnaya, Sweeper, Zucchero Squad, Springfield,
# Sharkry, Sangvis Ferri, Scarecrow, Ouroboros, Black Zone, Agent, Centaureissi, Master,
# Nyxie, Doll Community, Warmaster, Wildhunt, Dreamer, Griffin, Lentine, Foxtrot Squad,
# Delta Squad, Echo Squad, Roberti, Tours, Code Entropy, Kenny, Omen Squad, Yellow Zone,
# Elmo, Mayling, Colphne, Kalina, Kalin, Groza, Tokarev, Lind, Suomi, Ullrid, Vepley,
# Sabrina, Frostfall, Qiongjiu, Betis, Abigail, AUG, Loxis, Mokosh, Lee-Enfield, FN Squad,
# Palette Squad, Mosin-Nagant, Papasha, Nagant, Ksenia, Mica Port, Lewis, Leva, Lenna,
# B.U.G.s, Defy, Loreley, Green Zone, White Zone, Helian, Kuro, URNC, E.L.I.D., Frame.

(The most intense firefight of the entire battle was located on the main road area in front of Paradajz. For Mangi Security, as long as they broke through the defense here, they could suppress this town in the fastest way.)
column2: (Baku tembak paling sengit dari seluruh pertempuran itu berada di area jalan utama di depan Paradajz. Bagi Mangi Security, selama pertahanan di sini jebol, mereka bisa menekan kota ini dengan cara tercepat.)

column1: (After deploying multiple combat vehicles and heavy firepower mechs, as well as hundreds of military Dolls and automated weapons, Paradajz's fire points and defense equipment had been completely destroyed.)
column2: (Setelah mengerahkan beberapa kendaraan tempur dan mech berdaya tembak berat, serta ratusan Doll militer dan senjata otomatis, titik tembak dan perangkat pertahanan Paradajz sudah hancur sepenuhnya.)

column1: (Dushevnaya, Sweeper, and the Zucchero Squad that came to rendezvous became the last barrier here.)
column2: (Dushevnaya, Sweeper, dan Zucchero Squad yang datang bergabung menjadi penghalang terakhir di sini.)

column1: (Precisely because the battle was so intense, they didn't even have time to pay attention to the news of reinforcements arriving. Their battered frames were only delaying the time of fall as much as possible.)
column2: (Justru karena pertempurannya begitu sengit, mereka bahkan tidak sempat memperhatikan kabar datangnya bala bantuan. Frame mereka yang remuk hanya menunda waktu jatuhnya sebisa mungkin.)

column1: Commander, please bless the Hero and grant the power to protect everyone! Ugh—!
column2: Commander, tolong berkati sang Pahlawan dan berikan kekuatan untuk melindungi semuanya! Ugh—!

column1: Dushevnaya, don't push yourself, cover me from your position!
column2: Dushevnaya, jangan memaksakan diri, lindungi aku dari posisimu!

column1: Springfield, Sharkry's side is about to fall, I'm heading over!
column2: Springfield, sisi Sharkry hampir jatuh, aku ke sana!

column1: No, you and she retreat to the control room together. The enemy's next wave of heavy mechas is arriving soon!
column2: Jangan, kau dan dia mundur bersama ke ruang kontrol. Gelombang mecha berat musuh berikutnya segera datang!

column1: Damn it! Out of armor-piercing rounds...
column2: Sialan! Amunisi penembus baja habis...

column1: Whoa!
column2: Wah!

column1: (Although the Dolls are brave and skilled in battle, when a lineup of heavy mechas appears before them, they are forced into a desperate situation of powerlessness.)
column2: (Meski para Doll berani dan mahir bertempur, saat barisan mecha berat muncul di depan mereka, mereka terpaksa masuk ke situasi putus asa tanpa daya.)

column1: (And the turning point happens at this moment. As three dark figures crash into the battlefield like thunder, Mangi Security's formation is instantly torn apart in the eyes of the Dolls.)
column2: (Dan titik baliknya terjadi saat itu. Ketika tiga figur gelap menghantam medan tempur seperti guntur, formasi Mangi Security seketika tercabik di depan mata para Doll.)

column1: Excuse me.
column2: Permisi.

column1: Ahahaha———— You Griffin rookies, be moved, worship, kneel and sing praises.
column2: Ahahaha———— Anak-anak baru Griffin, terharulah, sembahlah, bersimpuh dan nyanyikan pujian.

column1: Your eternal Sangvis Ferri masters have returned!
column2: Guru Sangvis Ferri kalian yang abadi sudah kembali!

column1: Hey, hey, hey, Scarecrow, keep an eye on Ouroboros—her support fire is practically hitting us in the face!
column2: Hei, hei, hei, Scarecrow, awasi Ouroboros—tembakan dukungannya praktis mengenai wajah kami!

column1: What? You can't control her? That's your problem, isn't it? If you drop the ball again this time, go back to the Black Zone and eat dirt!
column2: Apa? Kau tidak bisa mengendalikannya? Itu masalahmu, kan? Kalau kali ini kau mengacau lagi, pulang ke Black Zone dan makan tanah!

column1: (The pitch-black Dolls were noisy, tearing apart all the heavy mechs while chatting and laughing, seemingly not taking Springfield and the others seriously at all.)
column2: (Para Doll berpakaian hitam pekat itu berisik, mencabik semua mech berat sambil mengobrol dan tertawa, sepertinya sama sekali tidak menganggap serius Springfield dan yang lain.)

column1: (Only one dignified Doll, who could only be described as elegant, walked towards them. She lifted her skirt and gave a slight bow, showing the utmost courtesy and attentiveness, yet her face showed not the slightest fluctuation.)
column2: (Hanya satu Doll berwibawa, yang hanya bisa digambarkan sebagai elegan, melangkah ke arah mereka. Dia mengangkat ujung roknya dan membungkuk sedikit, memperlihatkan kesopanan dan perhatian yang tertinggi, tapi wajahnya sedikit pun tidak beriak.)

column1: I apologize for being late.
column2: Saya mohon maaf karena terlambat.

column1: Are you... Agent? The Commander doesn't need any other maids by his side, but he does indeed need more warriors. Welcome back, comrade.
column2: Kau... Agent? Commander tidak butuh pelayan lain di sisinya, tapi dia memang butuh lebih banyak pejuang. Selamat datang kembali, rekan.

column1: Ms. Centaureissi, thank you for taking care of the Master in my absence.
column2: Ms. Centaureissi, terima kasih sudah menjaga Master selama saya tidak ada.

column1: Next, I will fulfill my duties. After this war is over, please hand over all management authority regarding Master's daily life to me.
column2: Setelah ini, saya akan menjalankan tugas saya. Begitu perang ini selesai, tolong serahkan seluruh wewenang pengurusan kehidupan sehari-hari Master kepada saya.

column1: Hmph! Putting on airs—but, you arrived just in time.
column2: Hmph! Berlagak—tapi, kau datang tepat waktu.

column1: There's no more reassuring ally at a time like this. Please take care of us in the upcoming operations.
column2: Tidak ada sekutu yang lebih menenangkan di saat seperti ini. Mohon kerja samanya di operasi berikutnya.

column1: This combat style... these weapons and equipment, these Dolls, could they be...
column2: Gaya tempur ini... senjata dan perlengkapan ini, Doll-Doll ini, jangan-jangan...

column1: Hmm? Why is there a fake-looking Sangvis Ferri here—Ah~ Are you that girl who got beaten up and cried on the island back then?
column2: Hmm? Kenapa ada Sangvis Ferri palsu di sini—Ah~ Kau anak yang dulu dihajar sampai menangis di pulau itu?

column1: I, I'm Sweeper! Are you the... Sangvis Ferri warriors who contacted me back then?
column2: A-aku Sweeper! Kalian... pejuang Sangvis Ferri yang dulu menghubungiku?

column1: What Sweeper? What use is a hindrance like you?
column2: Sweeper apa? Penghalang sepertimu ada gunanya?

column1: Hurry up and pick up the parts on the ground and clock out!
column2: Cepat pungut serpihan di tanah lalu pulang kerja!

column1: W-what do you mean!? I won't get in the way! Why don't you believe in my strength!?
column2: A-apa maksudmu!? Aku tidak akan menghalangi! Kenapa kalian tidak percaya kekuatanku!?

column1: If you had strength, the Commander wouldn't need to rely on us!
column2: Kalau kau punya kekuatan, Commander tidak perlu mengandalkan kami!

column1: There's no part for you to play now, just lie down like a good girl!
column2: Sekarang tidak ada bagian untukmu, berbaring saja seperti anak baik!

column1: Pah! You just have a bit more seniority, what's there to be arrogant about? I am the Warmaster of the Doll Community, the swordswoman who slayed the Wildhunt, the Sangvis Ferri Doll the Commander relies on the most! I'm the Senior now!
column2: Cih! Kalian cuma lebih senior sedikit, apa yang perlu disombongkan? Aku Warmaster Doll Community, pendekar wanita yang membunuh Wildhunt, Doll Sangvis Ferri yang paling diandalkan Commander! Sekarang akulah Senior-nya!

column1: Brat... so arrogant. If you dare get in the way, I'll dismantle you first, believe it or not? Huh?
column2: Anak kecil... sombong sekali. Kalau kau berani menghalangi, kau yang kubongkar pertama, mau percaya atau tidak? Hah?

column1: —I thought Nyxie was rebellious enough, but it turns out she's the most normal one among the Sangvis Ferri Dolls...
column2: —Kupikir Nyxie sudah cukup membangkang, ternyata dia yang paling normal di antara Doll Sangvis Ferri...

column1: Alright, everyone.
column2: Baik, semuanya.

column1: Right now, the Commander and our important partners from the Doll Community are in danger. After finishing the sweep here, we need to go support Miss Kalina's other combat zones!
column2: Sekarang Commander dan rekan penting kita dari Doll Community dalam bahaya. Setelah pembersihan di sini selesai, kita harus membantu zona tempur lain milik Miss Kalina!

column1: Agreed, this is a critical moment to fight for the Master.
column2: Setuju, ini momen krusial untuk bertarung demi Master.

column1: Dreamer, notify all members of Sangvis Ferri to engrave fear into the hearts of those humans.
column2: Dreamer, beri tahu semua anggota Sangvis Ferri untuk mengukir rasa takut di hati manusia-manusia itu.

column1: Let them fully experience the fact—that Sangvis Ferri has returned.
column2: Biarkan mereka merasakan sepenuhnya kenyataan—bahwa Sangvis Ferri sudah kembali.

column1: (On the battlefield, where the noise had tripled, the situation was shifting.)
column2: (Di medan tempur yang keriuhannya bertambah tiga kali lipat itu, situasinya bergeser.)

column1: (More and more Griffin Dolls and Sangvis Ferri entered the battlefield. Although the former military contracting company had been disbanded for years, their tactical skills and weapon-related experience completely returned to them in an instant.)
column2: (Makin banyak Doll Griffin dan Sangvis Ferri masuk ke medan tempur. Meski perusahaan kontraktor militer itu sudah bertahun-tahun bubar, kemahiran taktis dan pengalaman senjata mereka sepenuhnya kembali dalam sekejap.)

column1: (From then on, Mangi Security could no longer achieve the slightest combat result.)
column2: (Sejak itu, Mangi Security tidak lagi bisa meraih hasil tempur sedikit pun.)

column1: (Lentine frowned deeply, staring intently at the tactical terminal in front of her.)
column2: (Lentine mengerutkan dahi dalam-dalam, menatap lekat terminal taktis di depannya.)

column1: (The battle, which should have already been wrapped up and declared a victory, was now bogged down in a bizarre quagmire.)
column2: (Pertempuran yang seharusnya sudah dibereskan dan dinyatakan menang itu sekarang terbenam di rawa yang ganjil.)

column1: (The light dots representing friendly forces are extinguishing in swaths at a highly unnatural speed.)
column2: (Titik-titik cahaya yang melambangkan pasukan sendiri mati berbondong-bondong dengan kecepatan yang sangat tidak wajar.)

column1: Requesting backup—requesting backup!
column2: Meminta bantuan—meminta bantuan!

column1: Why can that kind of old-fashioned weapon cause this kind of damage—
column2: Kenapa senjata model tua seperti itu bisa menimbulkan kerusakan seperti ini—

column1: Foxtrot Squad! Answer me! Report the battle situation! Weren't you going to the rear to meet up with the supply unit?!
column2: Foxtrot Squad! Jawab aku! Laporkan situasi pertempuran! Bukannya kalian pergi ke belakang untuk bertemu unit pasokan?!

column1: Lentine, the signals for Foxtrot Squad and Delta Squad have all been lost...
column2: Lentine, sinyal Foxtrot Squad dan Delta Squad hilang semua...

column1: 30 people... from encountering the enemy to losing contact... it only took 1 minute?
column2: 30 orang... dari bertemu musuh sampai hilang kontak... cuma butuh 1 menit?

column1: What kind of Dolls are these? Sangvis Ferri? No... the gunfire heard over the comms just now wasn't from Sangvis Ferri weapon models at all!
column2: Doll macam apa mereka? Sangvis Ferri? Bukan... suara tembakan yang terdengar di komunikasi tadi sama sekali bukan dari model senjata Sangvis Ferri!

column1: Where are our reinforcements? Artillery positions! Reply immediately if you hear this!
column2: Mana bala bantuan kita? Posisi artileri! Segera jawab kalau mendengar ini!

column1: Unfortunately, the troops you mentioned have already gone to the next world ahead of you.
column2: Sayangnya, pasukan yang kau sebut sudah pergi ke dunia berikutnya mendahuluimu.

column1: Sister Lentine, our internal communication has been—
column2: Kak Lentine, komunikasi internal kita sudah—

column1: Echo Squad! Send someone to the artillery position immediately to confirm the situation.
column2: Echo Squad! Segera kirim orang ke posisi artileri untuk memastikan situasinya.

column1: Roberti, immediately contact the forces in the direction of Tours—
column2: Roberti, segera hubungi pasukan di arah Tours—

column1: I don't like killing, but my companions and I absolutely don't mind offering funeral flowers today to more people who try to harm this place.
column2: Aku tidak suka membunuh, tapi aku dan rekan-rekanku sama sekali tidak masalah menyediakan bunga pemakaman hari ini untuk lebih banyak orang yang mencoba merusak tempat ini.

column1: Adjutant Lentine? This is Echo squad... we can't get close to the artillery positions!
column2: Adjutant Lentine? Ini regu Echo... kami tidak bisa mendekat ke posisi artilerinya!

column1: Vehicle 4 has been penetrated?! Is it an anti-materiel weapon?! They have a sniper!
column2: Kendaraan 4 tertembus?! Apa itu senjata antimateriil?! Mereka punya penembak jitu!

column1: Fall back... fall back quickly... Aaaaaah!
column2: Mundur... cepat mundur... Aaaaaah!

column1: 此路不通。
column2: Jalan ini tertutup.

column1: Damn it...
column2: Sialan...

column1: (Lentine shoved the console in front of her away and hurriedly switched the communication to another backup terminal.)
column2: (Lentine menyingkirkan konsol di depannya dan buru-buru mengalihkan komunikasinya ke terminal cadangan lain.)

column1: (However, just as the channel connected, an extremely piercing high-frequency electronic screech came through, shocking Lentine and Roberti into involuntarily covering their ears in pain.)
column2: (Namun begitu salurannya tersambung, lengkingan elektronik berfrekuensi tinggi yang sangat menusuk masuk, membuat Lentine dan Roberti tanpa sadar menutup telinga karena sakit.)

column1: What's going on with the tactical and communication systems...
column2: Ada apa dengan sistem taktis dan komunikasinya...

column1: Our system... has been hacked.
column2: Sistem kita... dibajak.

column1: No, that's not quite right. It should be said that someone used some unknown logic virus to completely cut off our system from the frontline troops...
column2: Bukan, tidak tepat begitu. Lebih tepatnya ada yang memakai semacam virus logika tak dikenal untuk memutus total sistem kita dari pasukan garis depan...

column1: Is there a way to solve it?
column2: Ada cara mengatasinya?

column1: N-No, I've never seen this virus before... and the firewall can't detect it either.
column2: T-tidak, saya belum pernah melihat virus ini... dan firewall-nya juga tidak bisa mendeteksinya.

column1: Code Entropy... these viruses... seem to be able to completely ignore our firewall!
column2: Code Entropy... virus-virus ini... sepertinya bisa mengabaikan firewall kita sepenuhnya!

column1: ...We should have completely mastered that system permission... To release a virus of this magnitude in an instant, is it Sangvis Ferri's doing? Or... does he have some trump card I don't know about...
column2: ...Kita seharusnya sudah sepenuhnya menguasai izin sistem itu... Melepas virus sebesar ini dalam sekejap, apa ini ulah Sangvis Ferri? Atau... dia punya kartu andalan yang tidak kuketahui...

column1: Why, why...
column2: Kenapa, kenapa...

column1: (On the holographic screen, glaring red error pop-ups cascaded down like a waterfall, mixed with desperate SOS signals from the frontline troops.)
column2: (Di layar holografisnya, jendela galat merah menyala mengalir turun seperti air terjun, bercampur sinyal SOS penuh keputusasaan dari pasukan garis depan.)

column1: (The battle situation, which was originally a sure thing and settled, was completely overturned in just a few minutes by a force coming from nowhere.)
column2: (Situasi pertempuran yang semula sudah pasti dan selesai itu benar-benar dijungkirkan hanya dalam beberapa menit oleh kekuatan yang datang dari entah mana.)

column1: Did my tactical planning have a loophole? No... impossible.
column2: Apa perencanaan taktisku punya celah? Tidak... mustahil.

column1: Even if the issue of my logistics supply line being stretched too long has been exposed, the firepower suppression just now clearly locked in the victory... Not to mention I prepared three layers of backup!
column2: Meski masalah jalur pasokan logistikku yang terentang terlalu panjang sudah terbongkar, tekanan daya tembak tadi jelas sudah mengunci kemenangan... Apalagi aku menyiapkan tiga lapis cadangan!

column1: Are the elites that suddenly popped up on the enemy side too strong? But even if a more brilliant commander took over halfway, with Sangvis Ferri's support, it's impossible to instantly reverse this absolute disadvantage without resources.
column2: Apa elite yang tiba-tiba muncul di pihak musuh terlalu kuat? Tapi meski komandan yang lebih brilian mengambil alih di tengah jalan, dengan dukungan Sangvis Ferri, mustahil membalikkan ketertinggalan mutlak ini seketika tanpa sumber daya.

column1: Was I too careless? No, I had already deduced and blocked all retreat and reinforcement routes...
column2: Apa aku terlalu lengah? Tidak, aku sudah menghitung dan menutup semua rute mundur dan bala bantuan...

column1: (Lentine stared at the jumping garbled code with red eyes, muttering to herself, trying to find a convincing reason for failure from the fragmented battle situation.)
column2: (Lentine menatap kode acak yang berkedip dengan mata merah, bergumam pada dirinya sendiri, mencoba menemukan alasan kegagalan yang meyakinkan dari situasi pertempuran yang berkeping-keping.)

column1: (Tactical deployment, strategic vision, battle situation deduction... In order to fight that person, she believed she had done the utmost she could.)
column2: (Penempatan taktis, visi strategis, deduksi situasi pertempuran... Demi bertarung dengan orang itu, dia yakin dia sudah melakukan yang paling maksimal.)

column1: (The only miscalculation was that enemy reinforcement that descended like ghosts.)
column2: (Satu-satunya salah hitungnya adalah bala bantuan musuh yang turun seperti hantu itu.)

column1: No! This isn't a miscalculation... Where on earth did this unit come from...
column2: Bukan! Ini bukan salah hitung... Sebenarnya unit ini datang dari mana...

column1: The power I bet everything to obtain... and that person... that guy who hasn't even shown their face has actually possessed this kind of power all along?!
column2: Kekuatan yang kupertaruhkan segalanya untuk kudapatkan... dan orang itu... orang yang bahkan belum menampakkan wajahnya ternyata sejak dulu punya kekuatan seperti ini?!

column1: Do Griffin's Dolls... trust you that much?!
column2: Apa Doll Griffin... memercayaimu sebesar itu?!

column1: Even though... you're not even there...!
column2: Padahal... kau bahkan tidak ada di sana...!

column1: You're not even... You! Are! Not! Even! There!!!
column2: Kau bahkan tidak... Kau! Tidak! Ada! Di! Sana!!!

column1: (Lentine's lips trembled violently from extreme unwillingness and anger. She bit her lip hard until a few sweet, scarlet traces of blood seeped out.)
column2: (Bibir Lentine bergetar keras karena ketidakrelaan dan kemarahan yang ekstrem. Dia menggigit bibirnya kuat sampai beberapa jejak darah merah yang terasa manis merembes keluar.)

column1: (She pulled at her hair almost uncontrollably, messing up her gorgeous red hair until it fell disheveled over her shoulders.)
column2: (Dia menjambak rambutnya nyaris tanpa kendali, mengacak rambut merahnya yang indah sampai jatuh berantakan di bahunya.)

column1: (Under the suffocating pressure, she subconsciously turned her head away.)
column2: (Di bawah tekanan yang menyesakkan, tanpa sadar dia menoleh ke samping.)

column1: (This is an instinct developed from countless shared missions. As long as she calls out that name—as long as she says that name, that familiar figure will timely make a few passionate yet naive remarks, helping her regain some calm.)
column2: (Itu insting yang tumbuh dari misi bersama yang tak terhitung. Selama dia menyebut nama itu—selama dia mengucapkan nama itu, figur yang dia kenal akan tepat waktu melontarkan beberapa ucapan penuh semangat tapi naif, membantunya kembali sedikit tenang.)

column1: (But this time, no one responded.)
column2: (Tapi kali ini, tidak ada yang menjawab.)

column1: (Lentine froze, her turning motion stiffening mid-air. The adjutant's position beside her was empty, and only the cold flickering light of the screen stung her eyes.)
column2: (Lentine terpaku, gerakan menolehnya mengeras di udara. Posisi adjutant di sebelahnya kosong, dan hanya cahaya layar yang berkelip dingin menusuk matanya.)

column1: (Kenny is no longer here.)
column2: (Kenny sudah tidak ada di sini.)

column1: (Not just Kenny, but those old faces who had gone through life and death with her in Mangi Security, entrusting their backs to each other in hails of bullets, have all been forever left behind in those extreme missions classified as top secret.)
column2: (Bukan cuma Kenny, tapi wajah-wajah lama yang pernah melewati hidup dan mati bersamanya di Mangi Security, saling memercayakan punggung di tengah hujan proyektil, semuanya tertinggal selamanya di misi-misi ekstrem berlabel rahasia tertinggi itu.)

column1: (In the large, cold command room filled with instruments, only her own heavy breathing echoes. Having come this far, she can't even find a single person to whom she can drop her disguise and confess even a hint of weakness.)
column2: (Di ruang komando yang besar, dingin, dan penuh instrumen itu, hanya napas beratnya sendiri yang bergaung. Sampai sejauh ini, dia bahkan tidak bisa menemukan satu orang pun tempat dia bisa melepas topengnya dan mengakui sedikit saja kelemahan.)

column1: (Since when, their team name was lost, and they were called the 'Omen Squad' by others.)
column2: (Entah sejak kapan, nama regu mereka hilang, dan mereka disebut 'Omen Squad' oleh orang lain.)

column1: (They were always facing misfortune, and overcoming it time and time again.)
column2: (Mereka selalu berhadapan dengan kesialan, dan mengatasinya berkali-kali.)

column1: (Lentine stared intently at the battle casualty list on the screen, suddenly pulling a mournful smile that was uglier than crying.)
column2: (Lentine menatap lekat daftar korban tempur di layar, lalu tiba-tiba menarik senyum duka yang lebih buruk daripada tangisan.)

column1: (And now, misfortune had finally swallowed everyone, leaving her alone in this command room that was like a mausoleum.)
column2: (Dan sekarang kesialan itu akhirnya menelan semua orang, meninggalkannya sendiri di ruang komando yang seperti makam ini.)

column1: (She had finally completely become a true 'Omen'.)
column2: (Dia akhirnya benar-benar menjadi 'Omen' yang sesungguhnya.)

column1: ...Sister Lentine?
column2: ...Kak Lentine?

column1: (Roberti's timid voice barely called back Lentine's sanity, which was on the verge of collapse. She suddenly closed her eyes and took a deep breath of cold air filled with the smell of gunpowder smoke.)
column2: (Suara Roberti yang penakut nyaris tidak sanggup memanggil kembali kewarasan Lentine yang di tepi keruntuhan. Dia mendadak menutup mata dan menarik napas panjang dari udara dingin yang penuh bau asap mesiu.)

column1: (The person who could act as her 'tranquilizer' is no longer here. She must force herself to swallow those weak emotions along with the blood, forcing reason to regain control of this body.)
column2: (Orang yang bisa jadi 'penenang'-nya sudah tidak ada. Dia harus memaksa dirinya menelan emosi lemah itu bersama darahnya, memaksa nalar merebut kembali kendali tubuh ini.)

column1: (She absolutely cannot fall here.)
column2: (Dia sama sekali tidak boleh tumbang di sini.)

column1: (Absolutely not.)
column2: (Sama sekali tidak.)

column1: Roberti... notify all combat squads... to retreat.
column2: Roberti... beri tahu semua regu tempur... untuk mundur.

column1: No matter what method is used, whether it's shortwave communication, open unencrypted channels, or sending someone directly to convey it face-to-face.
column2: Cara apa pun boleh dipakai, entah komunikasi gelombang pendek, saluran terbuka tanpa enkripsi, atau mengirim orang untuk menyampaikannya langsung.

column1: Prioritize ensuring the safe evacuation of heavy armored units and Omen teams... abandon all positions.
column2: Dahulukan memastikan penarikan aman unit lapis baja berat dan regu Omen... tinggalkan semua posisi.

column1: Lentine, is this really okay?
column2: Lentine, ini benar-benar tidak masalah?

column1: It's fine. The most important thing for us right now is to preserve our trump cards.
column2: Tidak masalah. Yang paling penting bagi kita sekarang adalah menjaga kartu andalan kita.

column1: Be a good girl and go now.
column2: Jadilah anak baik dan pergilah sekarang.

column1: Hmm... I understand.
column2: Hmm... aku mengerti.

column1: (Roberti's footsteps hurried away. After she left the command room, Lentine slumped dejectedly into her chair. Trembling, she pulled a squashed cigarette from her pocket and clicked her lighter.)
column2: (Langkah Roberti bergegas menjauh. Setelah dia meninggalkan ruang komando, Lentine terkulai lesu di kursinya. Dengan gemetar dia menarik sebatang rokok yang sudah penyet dari kantongnya dan menjentikkan pemantiknya.)

column1: (But she didn't bring the cigarette to her lips. Instead, she quietly held it between her fingers, letting the crimson glow flicker in the dim room.)
column2: (Tapi dia tidak membawa rokok itu ke bibirnya. Dia hanya menahannya di antara jarinya dalam diam, membiarkan bara merahnya berkelip di ruangan yang redup.)

column1: (Until the scalding cigarette ash fell, leaving a stinging red mark on the back of her hand.)
column2: (Sampai abu rokok yang membakar itu jatuh, meninggalkan bekas merah yang menyengat di punggung tangannya.)

column1: (She jolted awake and took a deep breath.)
column2: (Dia tersentak sadar dan menarik napas panjang.)

column1: ...Fuck!
column2: ...Sialan!

column1: (The stench of rust and blood intertwined and hovered over the battlefield.)
column2: (Bau besi berkarat dan darah berjalin dan menggantung di atas medan tempur.)

column1: (Even though the artillery fire had subsided and the remaining enemies had retreated, the heavy burden known as 'war' still pressed down hard on everyone's hearts.)
column2: (Meski tembakan artileri sudah mereda dan musuh yang tersisa sudah mundur, beban berat bernama 'perang' tetap menekan keras hati semua orang.)

column1: (In the center of the devastated Paradajz, the bright yellow behemoth that had shielded everyone from the wind and rain countless times in the Yellow Zone—the Elmo—now lay lifelessly in the ruins.)
column2: (Di tengah Paradajz yang hancur, raksasa kuning cerah yang tak terhitung kali melindungi semua orang dari angin dan hujan di Yellow Zone—Elmo—sekarang terbaring tanpa nyawa di antara puing.)

column1: (The terrifying hole pierced by the enemy's main cannon at the rear of the vehicle, along with the spiderweb-like scratches and craters on its surface, silently declared that this steel behemoth and the companions it carried had been pushed beyond their limits.)
column2: (Lubang mengerikan yang ditembus meriam utama musuh di bagian belakang kendaraannya, bersama goresan mirip sarang laba-laba dan kawah di permukaannya, tanpa suara menyatakan bahwa raksasa baja ini dan rekan-rekan yang dibawanya sudah didorong melewati batasnya.)

column1: Mayling, why don't you... go rest at the camp first? Leave things here to us.
column2: Mayling, bagaimana kalau kau... istirahat dulu di kamp? Serahkan urusan di sini pada kami.

column1: (Looking at Mayling, who was covered in grease with hollow, exhausted eyes, Colphne couldn't help but speak softly. Words of comfort seemed so pale and powerless in the face of such tragic battle damage, catching in her throat.)
column2: (Menatap Mayling yang berlumur gemuk dengan mata cekung dan kelelahan, Colphne tak bisa menahan diri untuk bicara lembut. Kata-kata penghibur terasa begitu pucat dan tak berdaya di depan kerusakan tempur yang tragis itu, tersangkut di tenggorokannya.)

column1: (Mayling seemed not to hear Colphne's words.)
column2: (Mayling sepertinya tidak mendengar kata-kata Colphne.)

column1: (She walked to the huge hole as if she had lost her soul, gently stroking The Elmo's broken and cold metal shell, and mechanically pulled out repair tools from her waist.)
column2: (Dia melangkah ke lubang raksasa itu seolah kehilangan jiwanya, mengusap lembut badan logam The Elmo yang pecah dan dingin, lalu secara mekanis menarik peralatan perbaikan dari pinggangnya.)

column1: (But her hands trembled, and she gestured with the wrench on the fuselage for a long time, unable to find a place to start repairing.)
column2: (Tapi tangannya gemetar, dan dia mengarahkan kunci itu ke badan kendaraannya lama sekali tanpa bisa menemukan tempat untuk mulai memperbaiki.)

column1: ...I'm sorry... I will definitely fix you...
column2: ...Maafkan aku... aku pasti akan memperbaikimu...

column1: ...I have to fix it... that way, when the Commander comes back, they'll have a home to return to...
column2: ...Aku harus memperbaikinya... supaya kalau Commander kembali, dia punya rumah untuk dituju...

column1: The Commander... our Elmo...
column2: Commander... Elmo kita...

column1: (Clang—)
column2: (Trang—)

column1: (The heavy wrench slipped from Mayling's strengthless fingertips and smashed onto the ground covered in shell casings.)
column2: (Kunci yang berat itu terlepas dari ujung jari Mayling yang kehabisan tenaga dan jatuh menghantam tanah yang penuh selongsong.)

column1: Mayling, you really need to rest. I...
column2: Mayling, kau benar-benar harus istirahat. Aku...

column1: N-No... I still have to fix The Elmo.
column2: T-tidak... aku masih harus memperbaiki The Elmo.

column1: It's okay, Colphne... I'll fix your Frame soon too...
column2: Tidak apa-apa, Colphne... Frame-mu juga akan segera kuperbaiki...

column1: (Dragging her body that was almost falling apart, Mayling bent down and stubbornly picked up the heavy wrench again, trying to force a severely twisted and deformed metal plate back into its place.)
column2: (Menyeret tubuhnya yang hampir berantakan, Mayling membungkuk dan dengan keras kepala kembali memungut kunci berat itu, mencoba memaksa lempeng logam yang bengkok parah kembali ke tempatnya.)

column1: (Her unsteady footsteps and trembling wrists made it obvious to anyone that this tightly stretched string could snap at any moment.)
column2: (Langkahnya yang tidak mantap dan pergelangan tangannya yang gemetar membuat siapa pun jelas melihat bahwa dawai yang ditarik kencang itu bisa putus kapan saja.)

column1: (It was also at this time that a touch of gentle orange extended a helping hand to the girl.)
column2: (Dan pada saat itu juga, sentuhan warna oranye yang lembut mengulurkan tangan untuk gadis itu.)

column1: Mayling, stop.
column2: Mayling, berhenti.

column1: (A gentle yet undeniable hand firmly grasped Mayling's arm in mid-air.)
column2: (Sebuah tangan yang lembut tapi tak bisa dibantah mencengkeram kuat lengan Mayling di udara.)

column1: (A bright touch of orange appeared in Mayling's red and swollen eyes. Before this, they had never truly met in reality.)
column2: (Sentuhan oranye yang cerah muncul di mata Mayling yang merah dan bengkak. Sebelum ini, mereka belum pernah benar-benar bertemu di kenyataan.)

column1: (But she knew this person. From the Commander's countless nostalgic mentions, and from the voice that matched the one on the comms channel, she immediately recognized the identity of the person before her.)
column2: (Tapi dia tahu orang ini. Dari sebutan penuh kenangan yang tak terhitung dari Commander, dan dari suara yang cocok dengan yang ada di saluran komunikasi, dia langsung mengenali identitas orang di depannya.)

column1: (And Mayling also knew that the other party had long been aware of her existence.)
column2: (Dan Mayling juga tahu pihak itu sudah lama mengetahui keberadaannya.)

column1: Miss... Kalina... please let me go... I'm fine...
column2: Miss... Kalina... tolong lepaskan aku... aku tidak apa-apa...

column1: This is my work...
column2: Ini pekerjaanku...

column1: (Mayling subconsciously tried to break free from Kalina's arm, but currently on the verge of her physiological limits, any of her movements were too weak.)
column2: (Tanpa sadar Mayling mencoba melepaskan diri dari tangan Kalina, tapi karena sekarang dia di tepi batas fisiknya, gerakan apa pun darinya terlalu lemah.)

column1: Your body has already reached its limit.
column2: Tubuhmu sudah mencapai batasnya.

column1: ...It's fine... This is my job...
column2: ...Tidak apa-apa... Ini tugasku...

column1: I have to fix The Elmo... and repair... everyone... I...
column2: Aku harus memperbaiki The Elmo... dan memperbaiki... semuanya... aku...

column1: ...I know, I understand everything, and I completely comprehend.
column2: ...Aku tahu, aku memahami semuanya, dan aku sepenuhnya mengerti.

column1: That thought of doing whatever it takes, keeping yourself moving, even pushing yourself to the limit... just to see that person again and stand by his side.
column2: Pikiran untuk melakukan apa pun, terus menggerakkan diri, bahkan mendorong diri sampai batas... hanya untuk bertemu orang itu lagi dan berdiri di sisinya.

column1: (Kalina leans down slightly, quietly gazing into Mayling's eyes with a sincere and forgiving look.)
column2: (Kalina membungkuk sedikit, menatap mata Mayling dalam diam dengan tatapan yang tulus dan memaafkan.)

column1: (As if through these eyes full of panic and despair, she saw the shadow of that young logistics officer who had struggled in pain countless times ten years ago.)
column2: (Seolah lewat mata yang penuh panik dan keputusasaan itu, dia melihat bayangan petugas logistik muda yang tak terhitung kali bergulat dalam kesakitan sepuluh tahun lalu.)

column1: Just like the reason you push yourself, you are his current logistics officer, and your battle is not over yet.
column2: Sama seperti alasan kau mendorong dirimu, kau adalah petugas logistiknya sekarang, dan pertarunganmu belum berakhir.

column1: Because of this, you must rest and recuperate for the reunion later.
column2: Karena itu, kau harus beristirahat dan memulihkan diri demi pertemuan nanti.

column1: Right now, there's me, Groza, our companions from Griffin and the Elmo, and everyone from the Doll Community here.
column2: Sekarang ada aku, Groza, rekan-rekan kita dari Griffin dan Elmo, dan semua orang dari Doll Community di sini.

column1: So... don't push yourself anymore. Right now, if you want to cry, just cry out loud.
column2: Jadi... jangan memaksakan diri lagi. Sekarang, kalau ingin menangis, menangislah sekencang-kencangnya.

column1: Ah... ahh... Waaaaaahhhhh!
column2: Ah... ahh... Huwaaaaaa!

column1: The Elmo is gone, the Commander is missing... Our home... Waaaaaah.
column2: The Elmo hancur, Commander hilang... Rumah kita... Huwaaaaa.

column1: I... I didn't manage to do anything... Waaaaaahhhhh!
column2: A-aku tidak berhasil melakukan apa pun... Huwaaaaaa!

column1: (That strong defense line, which had been forcefully supported by a sense of mission and meager willpower, completely collapsed at this moment.)
column2: (Garis pertahanan yang kuat, yang dipaksa berdiri oleh rasa tanggung jawab dan sisa kemauan yang tipis itu, benar-benar runtuh saat itu.)

column1: (The long-suppressed torrent of emotions broke through the girl's throat, turning into heart-wrenching cries that echoed across the empty ruins.)
column2: (Arus emosi yang lama ditahan itu menerobos tenggorokan gadis itu, berubah menjadi tangisan yang menyayat hati dan bergaung di puing yang kosong.)

column1: (Kalina didn't say anything more, just hugged Mayling tightly, gently stroking her trembling back, letting her vent all her tears and despair onto her coat.)
column2: (Kalina tidak berkata apa-apa lagi, hanya memeluk Mayling erat, mengusap lembut punggungnya yang bergetar, membiarkannya meluapkan semua tangis dan keputusasaannya ke mantelnya.)

column1: It's okay, that person will definitely be fine.
column2: Tidak apa-apa, orang itu pasti akan baik-baik saja.

column1: Although the difficulties that person has to face now... might far exceed your and my imagination, that person will definitely return to us safely, just like the countless times they overcame desperate situations in the past.
column2: Meski kesulitan yang harus dia hadapi sekarang... mungkin jauh melampaui bayanganmu dan bayanganku, orang itu pasti akan kembali kepada kita dengan aman, seperti tak terhitung kali dia melewati situasi putus asa di masa lalu.

column1: So, believe in him, okay.
column2: Jadi, percayalah padanya, ya.

column1: Yeah... yeah... I believe... I believe *sob*... the Commander will be fine... definitely...
column2: Iya... iya... aku percaya... aku percaya *hiks*... Commander akan baik-baik saja... pasti...

column1: Waaaaaah!
column2: Huwaaaaa!

column1: Miss Kalina, it's been a while.
column2: Miss Kalina, sudah lama tidak bertemu.

column1: Yeah, it's so good to see you. Tokarev, and Lind, thank you for your hard work.
column2: Iya, senang sekali bertemu kalian. Tokarev, dan Lind, terima kasih atas kerja kerasnya.

column1: (At Kalina's gentle gaze, Colphne stepped forward, supporting the exhausted Mayling who had cried herself out, and headed back to the safe camp to rest first.)
column2: (Atas tatapan lembut Kalina, Colphne melangkah maju, menopang Mayling yang kelelahan setelah menangis habis-habisan, dan membawanya kembali ke kamp yang aman untuk istirahat.)

column1: ...Sorry, Kalin... if only our support could have arrived a little earlier.
column2: ...Maaf, Kalin... kalau saja bantuan kami bisa datang sedikit lebih awal.

column1: The Commander, he...
column2: Commander, dia...

column1: (Kalina gently shakes her head, stopping Lind's self-blame.)
column2: (Kalina menggeleng lembut, menghentikan rasa bersalah Lind.)

column1: I believe... I believe the Commander will be fine.
column2: Aku percaya... aku percaya Commander akan baik-baik saja.

column1: What's more important right now is to immediately reorganize Paradajz's defense line and re-establish contact with the lost strongholds as soon as possible...
column2: Yang lebih penting sekarang adalah segera menyusun ulang garis pertahanan Paradajz dan membangun kembali kontak dengan markas-markas yang hilang secepat mungkin...

column1: Suomi, take a squad and clear the obstacles at the front of the position. Aside from reusable defensive structures, blow up and clear all other ruins. We must ensure our mobility routes are completely unobstructed.
column2: Suomi, bawa satu regu dan bersihkan penghalang di depan posisi. Selain struktur pertahanan yang masih bisa dipakai, ledakkan dan bersihkan semua puing lainnya. Kita harus memastikan rute gerak kita benar-benar bebas hambatan.

column1: Zucchero Squad, you're responsible for clearing out a safe area on the inside specifically for human casualties to rest.
column2: Zucchero Squad, kalian bertanggung jawab menyiapkan area aman di bagian dalam khusus untuk korban manusia beristirahat.

column1: But keep in mind, this is a town built by the Doll Community. Ensure the stability of the Doll Community and maintain a reasonable sense of distance. Prioritize repairing the water and power systems.
column2: Tapi ingat, ini kota yang dibangun Doll Community. Jaga kestabilan Doll Community dan pertahankan jarak yang wajar. Dahulukan perbaikan sistem air dan listriknya.

column1: Negotiations with humans... Miss Ullrid, could I ask you to join me as a representative for the negotiations later?
column2: Negosiasi dengan manusia... Miss Ullrid, bisakah kuminta kau bergabung bersamaku sebagai perwakilan negosiasi nanti?

column1: No problem... Thank you for your thorough consideration.
column2: Tidak masalah... Terima kasih atas pertimbanganmu yang menyeluruh.

column1: I'll go find a suitable position first.
column2: Aku akan mencari posisi yang cocok dulu.

column1: I'll take Vepley and Sabrina to go with you! After helping you clear the obstacles, we'll prioritize rebuilding the fortifications.
column2: Aku akan membawa Vepley dan Sabrina ikut denganmu! Setelah membantu membersihkan penghalangnya, kami akan mendahulukan pembangunan ulang bentengnya.

column1: Miss Kalin, you need to make sure you rest too, you look terrible.
column2: Miss Kalin, kau juga harus benar-benar istirahat, wajahmu buruk sekali.

column1: Don't worry, I will.
column2: Jangan khawatir, akan kulakukan.

column1: Next, there's signal communication with various areas, emergency repairs for damaged Dolls, and tracking the enemy's retreat movements...
column2: Berikutnya ada komunikasi sinyal dengan berbagai area, perbaikan darurat untuk Doll yang rusak, dan pelacakan gerak mundur musuh...

column1: Leave the perimeter patrol and enemy search tasks to Frostfall. Captain Qiongjiu and the others have already moved out...
column2: Serahkan tugas patroli tepi dan pencarian musuh pada Frostfall. Captain Qiongjiu dan yang lain sudah bergerak...

column1: We've established shortwave contact with Sangvis Ferri's Agent. They don't seem to plan on having too much direct contact with us for now, so they'll maintain independent operations.
column2: Kami sudah membangun kontak gelombang pendek dengan Agent dari Sangvis Ferri. Sepertinya mereka belum berniat banyak berkontak langsung dengan kita, jadi mereka akan tetap beroperasi mandiri.

column1: Anyway... we'll do our best to take over the defense lines and patrol routes they are currently responsible for.
column2: Pokoknya... kami akan berusaha sebaik mungkin mengambil alih garis pertahanan dan rute patroli yang sekarang mereka pegang.

column1: Regarding the enemy's movements, Betis and Abigail have already locked onto the retreating Mangi Security forces.
column2: Soal gerakan musuh, Betis dan Abigail sudah mengunci pasukan Mangi Security yang mundur.

column1: If there's any sign of them turning back to attack, the intelligence will be sent back here immediately. Also, AUG... Miss Loxis just informed me that their squad didn't stay here and has headed straight for Mokosh to support the comrades stranded there.
column2: Kalau ada tanda mereka berbalik menyerang, intelnya akan langsung dikirim ke sini. Selain itu, AUG... Miss Loxis baru memberitahuku bahwa regu mereka tidak tinggal di sini dan langsung menuju Mokosh untuk membantu rekan-rekan yang terjebak di sana.

column1: Miss Lee-Enfield took the FN Squad and the new Palette Squad to set up defenses in the Tours area.
column2: Miss Lee-Enfield membawa FN Squad dan Palette Squad yang baru untuk memasang pertahanan di area Tours.

column1: Actually... there are still many companions on their way. Mosin-Nagant was delayed due to an interception on the road, so she's a bit behind.
column2: Sebenarnya... masih banyak rekan yang sedang di jalan. Mosin-Nagant tertunda karena pencegatan di jalan, jadi dia agak terlambat.

column1: After hearing that the crisis on our side had been resolved just now, she already took Papasha, Nagant, and Ksenia and detoured to Mica Port to gather intel.
column2: Setelah mendengar krisis di sisi kita baru saja teratasi, dia langsung membawa Papasha, Nagant, dan Ksenia memutar ke Mica Port untuk mengumpulkan intel.

column1: There are still a bunch of people on the anonymous board clamoring to come over immediately. But considering their distance and current Frame conditions... we've temporarily forced them to stay put.
column2: Masih ada segerombolan orang di papan anonim yang berteriak ingin segera datang. Tapi mengingat jarak dan kondisi Frame mereka sekarang... kami sementara memaksa mereka tetap di tempat.

column1: Although a few protested particularly fiercely... sigh... why is it noisy over there too.
column2: Meski beberapa memprotes dengan sangat keras... haah... kenapa di sana juga ribut.

column1: Why isn't Lewis online? Wait, don't tell me I have to notify that side... It's such a hassle no matter who I contact.
column2: Kenapa Lewis tidak online? Tunggu, jangan bilang aku harus memberi tahu pihak itu... Menyusahkan sekali siapa pun yang kuhubungi.

column1: 大家……
column2: Semuanya...

column1: Everyone's response capabilities, tactical literacy, and even strategic vision are much more refined and mature than in the past.
column2: Kemampuan tanggap semua orang, literasi taktis, bahkan visi strategisnya jauh lebih halus dan matang dari dulu.

column1: If the Commander could see this now, they would definitely be very proud.
column2: Kalau Commander bisa melihat ini sekarang, dia pasti akan sangat bangga.

column1: After that parting, we also thought a lot.
column2: Setelah perpisahan itu, kami juga banyak berpikir.

column1: During countless nights of sleep... we rehearsed countless times in our neural cloud, rehearsing how we should fight if we ever faced a desperate situation again...
column2: Di malam-malam tidur yang tak terhitung... kami melatihnya berkali-kali di neural cloud, melatih bagaimana seharusnya kami bertarung kalau kembali menghadapi situasi putus asa...

column1: We've all been waiting, waiting for the day when the Commander can see our growth with their own eyes.
column2: Kami semua menunggu, menunggu hari ketika Commander bisa melihat pertumbuhan kami dengan mata sendiri.

column1: Yeah. Thanks to your current dispatching, the defense line and intelligence network should be fine now.
column2: Iya. Berkat pengaturanmu sekarang, garis pertahanan dan jaringan intelnya seharusnya sudah aman.

column1: But regarding intelligence on the external environment, we're still in the dark... Leva.
column2: Tapi soal intel lingkungan luar, kita masih gelap... Leva.

column1: Right after the battle ended, Lenna already took people to repair the communication base station.
column2: Tepat setelah pertempuran berakhir, Lenna sudah membawa orang untuk memperbaiki stasiun pangkalan komunikasi.

column1: Using the underlying technology provided by B.U.G.s, we can now barely send out weak signals.
column2: Dengan teknologi dasar yang disediakan B.U.G.s, sekarang kita nyaris bisa mengirim sinyal lemah.

column1: I prioritized trying to contact the emergency frequency left by the Defy squad, as well as Loreley and other Dolls currently on standby in the Green Zone and White Zone.
column2: Aku mendahulukan mencoba menghubungi frekuensi darurat yang ditinggalkan regu Defy, serta Loreley dan Doll lain yang sekarang bersiaga di Green Zone dan White Zone.

column1: However, perhaps due to interference from the aftermath of the information warfare just now... the response feedback of the communication signals is not optimistic.
column2: Namun mungkin karena gangguan sisa perang informasi tadi... umpan balik respons sinyal komunikasinya tidak menggembirakan.

column1: If needed, the Frostfall Squad's communication equipment can be lent to you as a relay station.
column2: Kalau perlu, perangkat komunikasi Frostfall Squad bisa dipinjamkan padamu sebagai stasiun relai.

column1: At least for now... Griffin's old signal bands shouldn't have been targeted by the enemy's monitoring network yet, so there's no problem using them as a hidden springboard for information.
column2: Setidaknya untuk sekarang... pita sinyal lama Griffin seharusnya belum jadi sasaran jaringan pengawasan musuh, jadi tidak masalah memakainya sebagai batu pijakan informasi yang tersembunyi.

column1: Moreover, Miss Helian is also still waiting in the rear for news of Miss Kalina's safety.
column2: Lebih dari itu, Miss Helian juga masih menunggu kabar keselamatan Miss Kalina di belakang.

column1: The anonymous board and underground livestream system that Kuro has been maintaining should also be usable. The physical location and signal relay station of that server are very special.
column2: Papan anonim dan sistem siaran langsung bawah tanah yang dirawat Kuro juga seharusnya bisa dipakai. Lokasi fisik dan stasiun relai sinyal server itu sangat khusus.

column1: Even the system the URNC is so proud of shouldn't be able to easily catch our information.
column2: Bahkan sistem yang dibanggakan URNC seharusnya tidak bisa dengan mudah menangkap informasi kita.

column1: I'll go arrange it right away.
column2: Aku akan segera mengaturnya.

column1: Kalin, Suomi was right just now, you really should go rest. Your current mental state is approaching its limit.
column2: Kalin, Suomi tadi benar, kau benar-benar harus istirahat. Kondisi mentalmu sekarang mendekati batasnya.

column1: Your battle isn't over either, and we need a clear head... Tokarev, could I trouble you to look after her here for a bit?
column2: Pertarunganmu juga belum berakhir, dan kita butuh kepala yang jernih... Tokarev, boleh kuminta kau menjaganya di sini sebentar?

column1: Of course. It's my honor.
column2: Tentu. Ini kehormatan bagiku.

column1: (The Dolls quickly dispersed after receiving their orders, methodically executing their respective instructions. Even though at this moment, they still couldn't meet the person they cherished the most.)
column2: (Para Doll cepat berpencar setelah menerima perintah, menjalankan instruksinya masing-masing dengan tertib. Meski saat itu mereka masih belum bisa bertemu orang yang paling mereka sayangi.)

column1: (However, the memories and tacit understanding forged in the fires of war and engraved at the bottom of their neural clouds allowed them to spontaneously make the most correct tactical judgments and actions for the person in their hearts, even without a command center.)
column2: (Namun ingatan dan pengertian tanpa kata yang ditempa di kobaran perang dan terukir di dasar neural cloud mereka memungkinkan mereka dengan sendirinya membuat penilaian dan tindakan taktis paling tepat untuk orang di hati mereka, bahkan tanpa pusat komando.)

column1: (Looking at the busy but unpanicked crowd before her, Kalina's vision blurred for a moment.)
column2: (Menatap kerumunan yang sibuk tapi tidak panik di depannya, pandangan Kalina sesaat mengabur.)

column1: (She gently turns her head, gazing at the distant horizon where the smoke of gunpowder has yet to dissipate.)
column2: (Dia menoleh pelan, menatap ufuk jauh tempat asap mesiu belum juga hilang.)

column1: (Even though she knows very well in her heart that the person she has been missing is not there right now.)
column2: (Meski di hatinya dia sangat tahu orang yang dia rindukan sekarang tidak ada di sana.)

column1: Commander... we always seem to miss each other...
column2: Commander... kita sepertinya selalu berselisih jalan...

column1: Even though I had made up my mind to abandon everything and hold onto you tightly this time... to be a willful, unreasonable woman that you couldn't do anything about...
column2: Padahal aku sudah memantapkan hati untuk meninggalkan segalanya dan memegangmu kuat-kuat kali ini... untuk jadi perempuan keras kepala dan tidak masuk akal yang tak bisa kau apa-apakan...

column1: But you still managed to run off to a place where my hands can't reach... Cough, cough cough—
column2: Tapi kau tetap berhasil kabur ke tempat yang tidak terjangkau tanganku... Uhuk, uhuk uhuk—

column1: (Covering her lips, Kalina suppressed the sudden discomfort in her body—she should have taken enough anti-E.L.I.D. medication before coming. This was just a reflexive action, because her state of mind seemed to have returned to the past.)
column2: (Menutup bibirnya, Kalina menahan rasa tidak nyaman yang tiba-tiba di tubuhnya—dia seharusnya sudah minum cukup obat anti-E.L.I.D. sebelum datang. Ini hanya gerak refleks, karena kondisi batinnya seolah kembali ke masa lalu.)

column1: (It should be said that it stirred up memories of a certain period—she tried her best to hold back her tears, not wanting the Dolls to notice her loss of composure.)
column2: (Lebih tepatnya itu mengaduk ingatan pada satu masa tertentu—dia berusaha sekuat tenaga menahan air matanya, tidak ingin para Doll menyadari dia kehilangan ketenangan.)

column1: Once again... this is too much...
column2: Sekali lagi... ini terlalu berat...

column1: Commander... please, you must return safely...
column2: Commander... kumohon, kau harus kembali dengan aman...

column1: I'm begging you...
column2: Aku memohon padamu...
